run_interaction_job: run interaction jobs by spinning up ECS dashboard sessions with a Docker image tag and task name
run_task_runner: run the TaskRunner to orchestrate data generators and job listeners for HITL retraining
create_interaction_job: create an InteractionJob with a specified number of instances, image tag, task name, and timeout
create_interaction_log_listener: create an InteractionLogListener that monitors logs for a given batch ID with a configurable timeout
register_data_generators_and_listeners: register InteractionJob data generators and InteractionLogListener job listeners with the TaskRunner before running
